title: Web Workers transferControlToOffscreen
product-requirement: Terminals MUST implement the transferControlToOffscreen method and allow an OffscreenCanvas to be transferred to a web worker using postMessage.
specification: The HTMLCanvasElement.transferControlToOffscreen() method transfers control to an OffscreenCanvas object which can be used to render off the main thread.
assertion: A canvas element's transferControlToOffscreen method returns an OffscreenCanvas that can be transferred to a worker via postMessage.

changelog.summary: Initial creation of Web Workers transferControlToOffscreen test
